notes.title: Give your Wish for Evelia! ❤️
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/904380/announcements/detail/3220549164240196010][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32941522/a94907f1282116b94a46b360d189399331b2fde6.jpg[/img][/url]

The release of [b]Vambrace: Cold Soul[/b] is very close - can you feel the ice cold atmosphere of the forbidden city? There is less than two weeks to go till the release on [b]28th May[/b]! Do you want to get even more stuff on the world of [b]Vambrace: Cold Soul[/b] with the games release? Than give your wish for Evelia and unlock free goodies, that will be included in the game here on Steam!
